assets.prompt: A cosmic view of many separate worlds floating in darkness, each inside its own faint glassy bubble, each a different colour and shape: a golden city of spires, a world of smoke-stacks and gears, a world of giant trees, a world of shadow and lantern light. Calm, wondrous, silent. Accent: each world's own colour on deep indigo.

Close on one glassy bubble wall: on one side a golden cathedral city at dawn, on the other side, just beyond the glass, the dim shape of a forest with glowing eyes. Neither side sees the other. Accent: gold on one side, green on the other.

A towering robed guardian figure (a Warden, face hidden in a hood of light) standing on a cliff at the edge of their world, one hand raised and resting on the glassy Ward that curves overhead like a sky. Solemn, protective. Accent: pale gold.

Several different Warden guardians, each in their own world, seen as small figures at the foot of the great glassy wall: a radiant angelic figure, a huge iron foundry machine, a vast beast-shape in the roots, a masked woman in shadow. Each keeps watch. Accent: a different light behind each.
The first crack: a single jagged violet-cyan line splitting across the glassy Ward sky above a golden city, people on the rooftops looking up. Ominous stillness. Accent: violet against gold.

The Ward shattering everywhere at once: the glass sky breaking into a storm of falling iridescent shards, rifts tearing open across the land, light pouring through. Huge scale, chaotic, beautiful. Accent: violet, cyan, iridescent white.

Through a fresh rift in a quiet machine-world street, wild things spill in: a vine-covered beast, a swirl of shadow birds, a floating golden relic. The machines turn to look. Accent: industrial orange, green, violet rift light.

A Warden guardian on their knees as dark tendrils of rift light wrap around them from a crack behind, their light turning from gold to sickly violet. Tragic, not gory. Accent: gold fading into violet.

A lone silhouetted figure stepping into a towering rift of violet and cyan light, their cloak whipping in the wind from it, the broken landscape of their home behind them. Accent: violet rift light, home sunset behind.

Three Riftwalkers standing on three separate floating rocks, each lit by the colour of their own world: a gold-armoured knight with a shield, a teal-armoured engineer with an orbiting drone, a tribal huntress with bone weapons. A rift crackles between them. Accent: gold, orange, green.

A wide shot of many tiny figures from different worlds walking along a path of floating stone through the Far Rifts, each carrying their own world's light (a lantern, a glowing blade, a spirit flame). Accent: many small warm lights in deep indigo.
A gloved hand closing around a glowing Ward shard, light spilling between the fingers. Behind, out of focus, the defeated silhouette of a huge Warden. Accent: iridescent shard light.

Two Riftwalkers from different worlds facing each other across a single glowing shard on a broken stone pedestal: a masked trickster with cards fanned in one hand, and a spellblade with a sword of starlight. Tense standoff. Accent: deep purple on one side, starlight blue on the other.
A translucent, ghostly copy of a Riftwalker, made of shifting violet light and floating cards, rising from a rift crack to face a living Riftwalker. Eerie. Accent: pale violet ghost light.

A Riftwalker pushing a glowing shard into a closing rift, the crack sealing with a flash; but in the distance behind them, three new cracks are already opening. Accent: bright seal flash, violet cracks.

The deepest rift: an endless chasm of violet and cyan, and at its bottom a vast dark shape with a single slow-pulsing violet glow, tendrils of rift light reaching up toward many tiny shards falling in. Never show its full form. Dread. Accent: violet and black.
Aurelion: a city of white marble and gold spires on terraced cliffs, cathedral bells, banners, rays of holy light through clouds. Accent: gold and white.
Nexus-9: a sprawling foundry world of towers, pipes, smoke and furnace glow, lightning harnessed between metal totems. Accent: industrial orange and electric blue.
Wyldmaw: a primeval forest of colossal trees with roots like teeth, mist, something huge moving in the canopy. Accent: deep green and amber.
Umbral Veil: a shadowed city of masks and lantern-lit theatres, crooked alleys, a velvet curtain sky. Accent: deep purple and lantern gold.
The Hollow Crown: the ruins of a crystal kingdom built around a fallen, still-glowing star, broken towers and floating shards. Accent: starlight blue and silver.
Gloomfen: a drowned marsh at night, half-sunk graves and dead trees, ghostly lights over black water. Accent: sickly green and bone white.

The Midden: an endless scrapheap where wreckage from many worlds has washed up: a broken golden spire, a rusted machine, a fallen tree, all heaped together under a dirty sky. Strangely homely, with a small campfire. Accent: rust and bottle green.
The Far Rifts: the space between worlds, floating islands of broken land from many worlds drifting in a void of violet and cyan cracks. Accent: violet, cyan, black.

Landscape 1920 x 1080. The title image of the game. A great shattering Ward sky over a broken landscape where pieces of several worlds collide (a golden spire, a foundry tower, a giant tree, a shadow theatre). In the LEFT half, four Riftwalkers stand ready on a ridge, backs half-turned, facing the storm: the Knight, the Engineer, the Trickster and the Spellblade. In the RIGHT half, calmer sky and a huge central rift with the faint violet glow of the Heart deep inside. Keep the upper right third calm enough for a logo. Epic, hopeful and dangerous at once.
The same scene, the same framing, WITHOUT the Riftwalkers (only the landscape and sky). Used behind the logo for the Steam library hero and the startup splash.

Use case: stylized-concept. A brand-new production fantasy GAME ARENA BACKDROP for CINDERVAULT, an ash-buried industrial empire whose armies emerge from living furnaces. Extremely wide panoramic 4:1 landscape composition, environment only. Painted polished card-game art with bold readable architectural shapes, subtle cel shading and soft distant contrast. Across the skyline: immense black basalt KILNS and blocky iron foundry citadels, rows of smoking chimneys, enormous glowing furnace doors, lava channels and suspended chain bridges, ash dunes beneath deep rust-colored smoke. Make the central landmark a colossal squat industrial furnace with four tall smokestacks and one orange fire door, not a palace. Restrained charcoal/iron/rust palette with warm orange seams. All important architecture in the middle vertical band; a narrow calm flat horizon along the bottom, no large foreground fighting platform. NO floating crowns, NO crowns of any kind, NO gothic cathedral, NO royal palace, NO people or creatures, NO UI/text/logos/labels/borders. Fill the canvas, no padding or blurred strips. Distinctive heavy industrial fantasy, rather than a fallen-star kingdom.
